scope:
Paired chained decider replays of the opening (turns 3-30) of five live
Religion-lane Lv 8 Deity games (6 players, Small Continents, Online),
2026-11-19/20: four whose first Settler was displaced by the religion claims
(Russia civvis-20261119T195219Z, Arabia civvis-20261120T003425Z, Mali
civvis-20261120T005009Z, Russia civvis-20261120T015835Z) and one where it was
not (Russia civvis-20261119T235505Z).

`religion-seat-second-city-first` is the only bit that varies. Each arm is one
persistent `civvis_orders --serve --fresh-board` process (the live bridge's
mode, so the opening book and the agent's memory carry across turns), built
from the branch (profile ci), with the run's own requested genome (why.log
line 1 `forced`, each as `--with`); the on arm adds `--with
religion-seat-second-city-first`. Before each turn its mirror's events.jsonl
is the live log cut after the FIRST state row of that turn. One read per turn.

Read per turn and arm: the capital's produce orders (the last is the head it
leaves) and its production journal. The off arm leaves the head the live seat
had on the next state row on 91 of 96 comparable turns.

The board each turn is the live board, so after the first turn the arms differ
it keeps following the off arm; later changes partly reflect the on process
re-deciding a queue whose host item it did not ask for. Replays never reach the
founding: whether a religion is still founded is not measured here. Nothing is
executed in Civ VI.
